note_title: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则

callouts.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#1
callouts.title: Liouville原则
callouts.body:
1. 对亚纯/全纯函数的模的上界估计，可以经由Cauchy积分公式，以及其衍生出来的Cauchy不等式，导出对函数导数(高阶导数)的模的估计。
2. 对亚纯函数/全纯函数的模在圆周上平均值的估计（也就是某种积分估计），可以经由Cauchy积分公式转换为对Laurent/Taylor级数的系数的估计。
3. 亚纯函数/全纯函数其导数的模，Laurent/Taylor展开的系数反过来又能说明函数的一些性质。

classification_result.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#1

if_strategy_template.summary_en: Bounds on the modulus or circular averages of holomorphic or meromorphic functions can be converted, via the Cauchy integral formula and Cauchy inequalities, into bounds on derivatives or Laurent/Taylor coefficients. These derivative and coefficient bounds can then be used to deduce structural properties of the function.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Use this strategy when a holomorphic or meromorphic function satisfies growth bounds, boundary integral bounds, or average-value estimates, and one wants to infer rigidity, vanishing, polynomiality, or coefficient constraints.

callouts.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#2
callouts.title: 问题2
callouts.body:
如果一个整函数的上界估计为,$$|f(z)|\leq M(1+|z|)^A,z\in
\mathbb{C}$$那么需要证明这个整函数就是一个最多$\lfloor A \rfloor$的多项式。

classification_result.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#2

if_problem.statement_en: If an entire function satisfies $$|f(z)|\\leq M(1+|z|)^A,\\quad z\\in \\mathbb{C},$$ prove that \(f\) is a polynomial of degree at most $$\\lfloor A \floor.$$

callouts.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#3
callouts.title: 问题3
callouts.body:
整函数$f(z)$满足不等式,$$\int_{0}^{2\pi}
|f(re^{i \theta})| d\theta < r^{1/2},\forall r >0$$ 证明函数为0.

classification_result.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#3

if_problem.statement_en: Let \(f(z)\) be entire and satisfy $$\\int_{0}^{2\\pi} |f(re^{i \	heta})|\\, d\	heta < r^{1/2},\\quad \\forall r>0.$$ Prove that \(f\\equiv 0\).

callouts.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#4
callouts.title: 问题4

classification_result.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#4

if_problem.statement_en: Suppose an entire function \(f\) satisfies $$|f(z)| \\leq \\frac{1}{|\\operatorname{Im}(z)|}.$$ Prove that \(f\\equiv 0\).
key_techniques: estimates on horizontal lines or shifted circles
prerequisites: basic properties of the imaginary part

callouts.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#5
callouts.title: 问题5
callouts.body: $\rho >0$整函数有上界估计$f(z) = O(e^{|z|^{\rho}})$并且对于$n>3$都有$f(\log(n))=0$。证明整函数是0.

classification_result.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#5

if_problem.statement_en: Let \(\ho>0\). An entire function satisfies the growth estimate $$f(z)=O\\bigl(e^{|z|^{\ho}}\\bigr)$$ and for every \(n>3\) one has $$f(\\log n)=0.$$ Prove that \(f\\equiv 0\).
key_techniques: zero set rigidity for entire functions
construction of an auxiliary function with prescribed zeros
prerequisites: order and growth of entire functions

callouts.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#6
callouts.title: 问题6
callouts.body: $f$是整函数$u(z) = \text{Re}(f)$是其实部,并且对于任意圆周$C_r(0)$上都有上界估计$$u(z)\leq Cr^s,s\geq 0$$那么整函数$f$是一个至多不超过$s$次的多项式。

classification_result.id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#6

if_problem.statement_en: Let \(f\) be entire, and let $$u(z)=\\operatorname{Re}(f(z))$$ be its real part. Suppose that on every circle \(C_r(0)\) one has the upper bound $$u(z)\\leq Cr^s,\\quad s\\geq 0.$$ Prove that \(f\) is a polynomial of degree at most \(s\).
key_techniques: harmonic estimates for the real part
Cauchy estimates via bounds on real part
polynomial growth criterion for entire functions
